_doc: Cursor's orchestrate plugin: a root planner decomposes a goal into tasks that isolated workers, subplanners, and verifiers take, talking upward through handoff files in git. The loop (scripts/) calls the Cursor SDK; those files are ports that a harness adapter replaces. Tickets are optional inputs the root planner reads. cursor-sdk is excluded because it documents the Cursor SDK the ports replace; upstream's tests are ignored until the adapter brings its own.

extra_needs.uses: The Andon stop signal and the run thread mirror go through Slack reactions and messages; the loop works without Slack.
extra_needs.question: Does the harness have a team-chat channel the loop can mirror to and read a stop signal from?
extra_needs.fallback: Keep the text; Slack is optional. Say how the harness's adapter carries the stop signal without it (the Amp adapter reads `andon.json` in the root workspace).

ports.name: agent-runtime
ports.interface: spawn, getRun, wait, stream, cancel, list, sendFollowUp, agentUrl
